usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Sierra Leone, reference rates as at 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: New leone (SLE) per US dollar; the World Bank series (21.30 for 2023) is older.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistics Sierra Leone, CPI press release August 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year national CPI inflation 15.66% in August 2026 (14.89% in July), up from 4.35% in December 2025; non-food inflation 23.54%, food 5.82%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Sierra Leone Monetary Policy Report, September 2026 (inflation expected to rise toward the low 20s by end-2026); CPI 2021-2025
inflation_projection.note: The 2021-2025 average (about 24%) is inflated by the 2022-2023 currency crisis and no credible numeric target exists, so we plan with 15%, near current inflation, between the BSL's near-term outlook and its single-digit medium-term objective under the IMF programme.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Sierra Leone, Monetary Policy Report September 2026 (MPC decision)
policy_rate.note: The MPC raised the Monetary Policy Rate by 0.25 points to 17.25% (SLF 21.25%, SDF 11.75%) at its Q3 2026 meeting (24 September 2026 per the BSL MPC calendar), after a rise to 17% in June 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bank of Sierra Leone, Monetary Policy Report September 2026, Table 3 (interest rates)
savings_account_rate.note: Average savings deposit rate 1.79% in July 2026, unchanged since January 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.note: The BSL Monetary Policy Report and interest rate file publish savings and lending rates only; no 3-month time deposit rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BSL Monetary Policy Report and interest rate file publish savings and lending rates only; no 1-year time deposit rate was found.

dps_rate.note: No published rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Sierra Leone
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 7.04% for 2025 (IMF IFS via World Bank); the BSL reports a savings rate of 1.79% in mid-2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No retail government savings certificate was found; individuals can buy Treasury bills and short bonds through commercial banks at BSL auctions.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The 91-day Treasury bill has not been issued since 2025 (BSL Monetary Policy Report September 2026, Table 3 shows 0). Latest auction (29 October 2026): 182-day 13.21%, 364-day 16.96%.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year bond auction was found; 2026 bond issues were mostly 2- to 3-year bonds priced at 18% (weighted average cost 17.69%, BSL Monetary Policy Report September 2026).

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond is issued in the domestic market; issuance is concentrated at 2-3 years (BSL Monetary Policy Report September 2026).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: National Revenue Authority, NRA Tax Guide 2022 (withholding tax on interest, Income Tax Act 2000 s.119)
tax_bank_interest.note: The NRA guide lists a 15% withholding tax on interest payments (Income Tax Act 2000, s.119). The guide is from 2022, older than 2025, and is hosted on an NRA content server; no newer official rate table was reachable, and whether the tax is final for resident individuals is not stated.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists. The Income Tax Act 2000 s.119(2) exempts interest on Government Development Stocks from withholding; the treatment of Treasury bill discounts for individuals was not confirmed.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A Deposit Protection Fund Act exists, but the BSL 2025 Financial Stability Report says the Fund awaits enactment of a revised Act; no cover limit was published.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published credit card rate was found; the BSL reports an average lending rate of 22.75% (June 2026).

equity_return_low.sourceName: No usable local equity index; global equity in leone terms
equity_return_low.note: Low case: weak global equity returns with slower leone depreciation.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity in leone terms; after-tax 364-day bill about 14.4%
equity_return_base.note: Sierra Leone's exchange lists very few companies, so equity means a global index in leone terms (about 7% in dollars plus expected depreciation), kept close to the after-tax bill rate rather than above it by a full premium.

equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equities and faster leone depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; leone 22.81 per US dollar on 30 October 2026 (BSL)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a stable leone, as in 2025-2026.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; leone 22.81 per US dollar on 30 October 2026 (BSL)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: about 4.5% dollar gold trend plus about 8% a year of leone depreciation, in line with an inflation gap of roughly 10-12 points.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; leone 22.81 per US dollar on 30 October 2026 (BSL)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and a repeat of the sharp depreciation of 2022-2023.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BSL: 364-day T-bill yield 16.96% (29 Oct 2026); savings deposits 1.79% (Jul 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest (NRA)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bill yields fall back as inflation is brought down, and savers mix bills with low-paying deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BSL: 364-day T-bill yield 16.96% (29 Oct 2026); savings deposits 1.79% (Jul 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest (NRA)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 364-day Treasury bills (about 14.4% after 15% tax), rounded down for reinvestment risk.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BSL: 364-day T-bill yield 16.96% (29 Oct 2026); savings deposits 1.79% (Jul 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest (NRA)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 2- to 3-year Treasury bonds at about 18% before tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio from the Sierra Leone Insurance Commission was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No regulator or official source publishing indicative term-life premiums was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official figure for the cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or official source publishing private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Sierra Leone
oop_health_share.note: 54.5% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Statistics Sierra Leone: health CPI up 11.75% year on year (August 2026); inflation assumption 15%
goal_inflation_health.note: Health costs are planned 1.5 points above general inflation, as most care is paid out of pocket and medicines are imported.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Statistics Sierra Leone: education services CPI up 8.59% year on year (August 2026); inflation assumption 15%
goal_inflation_education.note: Education fees have risen more slowly than prices lately, so they are planned at the general inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Sierra Leone
life_expectancy.note: 62.0 years in 2024 (men 60.2, women 63.7); UN WPP 2024 projects 62.3 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women except at 65, where the page gives 12.7.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+, computed as 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.6 in 2025 (World Bank) gives 18.0; 6.8 in 2040 and 12.1 in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/sierra-leone/2040/ and /2065/) give 14.7 and 8.3.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: NASSIT, FAQs and Benefits (old-age pension qualifying conditions)
retirement_age_default.note: Full NASSIT old-age pension at 60, described as the National Retirement Age, after at least 180 months of contributions; a reduced pension is possible from 55.

retirement_age_government.note: No official statement of the civil service retirement age was found; NASSIT's National Retirement Age of 60 applies to its pension, not necessarily to the end of public service.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BSL: 364-day T-bill yield 16.96% (29 Oct 2026); savings deposits 1.79% (Jul 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest (NRA)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: falling bill yields and low-paying deposits.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BSL: 364-day T-bill yield 16.96% (29 Oct 2026); savings deposits 1.79% (Jul 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest (NRA)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept below the 364-day bill yield after 15% tax (about 14.4%), allowing for yields to fall as inflation eases.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BSL: 364-day T-bill yield 16.96% (29 Oct 2026); savings deposits 1.79% (Jul 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest (NRA)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: rolling 2- to 3-year Treasury bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate about 13%; equity base 14%; gold base 13%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly bills and deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 13%; equity base 14%; gold base 13%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of Treasury bills, bonds, gold and global equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate about 13%; equity base 14%; gold base 13%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with more global equity and gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension was found; NASSIT benefits require 15 years of contributions.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension was found.

gratuity_rule.note: The private-sector end-of-service benefit rule in the Employment Act could not be read from an official source; NASSIT pays a separate retirement gratuity of 12 months of initial pension.

public_pension_scheme.note: Mandatory for formal employees: 5% employee plus 10% employer contributions (https://nassit.org.sl/our-services/contributions). Full pension from 60 after 180 months of contributions, reduced pension at 55-59: 30% of the best 60 months' average earnings plus 2% per extra 12 months, up to 80%, plus a retirement gratuity of 12 months' initial pension. No automatic indexation is stated.

savings_account.note: Average savings rate 1.79% (July 2026); 15% withholding tax on interest.

fdr_3m.note: Offered by banks; no published average rate.

fdr_1y.note: Offered by banks; no published average rate.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with published rates was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings certificate was found.

tbill_91d.note: Not issued since 2025; 182-day and 364-day bills are auctioned weekly and the public can apply through banks from NLe 5,000.

tbond_5y.note: Domestic bonds are mostly 2- to 3-year issues.

equity_fund.note: No locally sold diversified equity fund was confirmed; the local exchange lists very few companies.

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery and from artisanal mining; no official bullion or coin scheme was found.

insuranceComplaints.name: Sierra Leone Insurance Commission (SLICOM), contact
insuranceComplaints.note: No dedicated complaints page was found; complaints go to the Commission.

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security and Insurance Trust (NASSIT)
